description: VS Code Local agents, reusable engineering tools and an evidence-backed V-model, with an optional managed provider gateway.

languageModelTools.name: workforce_native_request
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Submit the ordinary requirement and professional software plan once. WorkForce owns valid native specialist calls, saved engineering identities, independent inspection, actual checks and acceptance. Optional plan.role_skills selects exact installed current workspace skill names per worker; omission uses ordinary project tools. Selection does not prove skill loading or use. Do not open a replacement request to retry an unfinished one.

role_skills.description: Optional explicit installed workspace skills assigned only to the named workers, at most eight distinct names across these roles. Missing or changed selections are not silently replaced. Omit to use ordinary project tools.

role_mcp.description: Optional User-approved MCP connector IDs for the named workers. The host binds exact observed tools; unavailable optional tools fall back to ordinary project work. Discovery is not proof of execution.

role_plugins.description: Optional exact owned native package names for each worker. The host pins approved source and full package registration; read only relevant package guidance. MCP tools still require separate approved role_mcp bindings; package agents/model rules do not replace WorkForce roles. Unavailable optional packages fall back to ordinary work.

Optional skills selects exact installed current workspace skill names with host-pinned receipts and files; omit for ordinary tools. Whole-product acceptance is not implied by a scoped professional report.

languageModelTools.name: workforce_native_prepare
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find relevant accepted experience and eligible project scripts before planning. Retrieval never starts a procedure or blocks ordinary implementation.

role.description: Optional professional role for advisory capability matching; this does not assign or invoke an agent.

workspace_folder.description: Exact absolute open workspace folder. Optional for one local folder; required when multiple projects are open.

languageModelTools.name: workforce_native_control
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect a public request key, recheck unchanged reviewed products after an environment correction or confirmed ended checker interruption, or explicitly resume retained findings or a backend-reconciled editor interruption. Preserve scope, history and repair allowance; keep the same request instead of submitting a replacement. Unknown effects are not blindly replayed.

request_key.description: The public request key returned by WorkForce, not a record, task or assignment ID.

action.description: Inspect results; recheck unchanged independently reviewed products after an environment correction or confirmed ended checker interruption; or explicitly resume retained findings or a backend-reconciled editor interruption. Saved scope and repair allowance remain unchanged; unconfirmed effects are not blindly replayed.

workspace_folder.description: Exact absolute open workspace folder. Optional for one local folder; required when multiple projects are open.

languageModelTools.name: workforce_native_capabilities
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search approved pinned capability catalogs, inspect a named package, install an exact portable skill, or view workspace skills. For full native packages use package-status, package-inspect and package-prepare with advertised professional source/package names only. The host checks exact reviewed file pins, caches source, and manages owned workspace registration; it never edits private native caches or global security. Package selection does not grant MCP tools or adopt foreign agent/model rules. Missing approval or optional capability uses ordinary-work fallback; do not repeat unchanged calls or override User-disabled packages.

source.description: An approved source_name returned by discovery/status; never a URL.

package.description: Exact catalog candidate name; required for inspect/install.

skill.description: Exact SKILL.md frontmatter name; required for install or actual-content inspection.

workspace_folder.description: Exact absolute open workspace folder. Optional for one local folder; required when multiple projects are open.

workforce.bridge.runtimePath.description: Absolute path to a trusted WorkForce package directory containing package.json and built dist. Read only from User settings.

workforce.capabilities.sources.description: Approved immutable public capability catalogs for native WF.PM. Read only from User settings; workspace overrides are ignored. An explicit empty User array disables external sources. Project network policy still controls downloads. Only portable skill files are installed, without hooks or MCP dependencies.

workforce.capabilities.mcpConnectors.description: User-approved exact native MCP tool names and references by professional role. Workspace overrides cannot grant tools. Availability means registered tools were observed, not that a server or model call succeeded.

workforce.gateway.nodePath.description: Optional absolute supported Node.js executable for the owned managed provider. Read from User settings; workspace overrides are ignored.

workforce.gateway.routingPolicy.description: Exact authorized managed model/combination pools. No models array permits directly selected routes. Combos require explicit pinned members; vision fallback must be explicit. Workspace overrides cannot broaden routing.

workforce.gateway.modelDeclarations.description: Optional explicit User capacity and tool/vision declarations for exact connected gateway IDs when upstream metadata is missing. Existing upstream declarations are retained. This does not verify upstream identity or grant native tool permissions.

workforce.capabilities.nativePackageSour.description: User-approved full canonical native package sources with immutable Git commit and exact reviewed file inventory. Read only from User settings; workspace overrides are ignored. Empty disables remote full-package preparation. Packages use owned workspace chat.pluginLocations registration; no private native install cache or global security settings are changed. MCP tool grants remain separately approved. Explicit User disable/remove is retained.

workforce.gateway.tokenSaving.description: Optional pinned upstream RTK for qualified routine progress tool output only. Read from User settings; workspace overrides are ignored. Diagnostics, assertions, acceptance evidence, source text and unfamiliar output remain uncompressed. Active calls retain their policy; pending configuration uses off without blocking the product. Byte savings do not establish billed-token savings.
